zh.title: 星宇航空空山金藝術機抵台20日首航東京成田
zh.summary: 星宇航空第二架藝術機空山金抵達台灣；八月二十日將首航東京成田
body: 星宇航空與日本藝術家空山基合作的第二架A350-1000藝術機「空山金」（機身編號 B-58554）於法國時間8月14日完成交機，並於8月16日上午9時43分順利抵達桃園機場。
該機規劃於8月20日正式執飛台北往返東京成田的JX800首航航班。為了展示該藝術機，星宇航空也規劃於東京成田國際機場（NRT）讓「空山金」與首架「空山銀」並肩亮相，並於8月26日飛航曼谷。
隨著該機加入，星宇航空整體機隊規模已達36架，其中包含4架A350-1000型客機。星宇航空表示，該型機具備遠程飛航與高載客量優勢，將持續支撐中長程航網成長。

en.title: Starlux Airlines Art Aircraft AIRSORAYAMA GOLD Arrives in Taiwan
en.summary: Starlux Airlines art aircraft AIRSORAYAMA GOLD arrived in Taiwan before its August 20 Tokyo debut.
body: Starlux Airlines' second Airbus A350-1000 art aircraft, named AIRSORAYAMA GOLD (registration B-58554), arrived at Taoyuan Airport on August 16, 2026. The aircraft, designed in collaboration with Japanese artist Hajime Sorayama, completed its delivery in France on August 14.

The aircraft is scheduled to make its inaugural flight from Taipei to Tokyo Narita on August 20, operating flight JX800. Starlux Airlines plans to showcase AIRSORAYAMA GOLD alongside its sister aircraft AIRSORAYAMA SILVER at Tokyo Narita International Airport (NRT), and also plans to operate the aircraft to Bangkok on August 26.

With this addition, the airline's active fleet has expanded to 36 aircraft, including four A350-1000s. Starlux Airlines stated that the A350-1000 will serve as a core model to support its long-haul network expansion.

zh.title: 倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）水管破裂淹水 聯合與美國及達美航廈道路受阻
zh.summary: 倫敦希斯洛機場爆水管導致周邊道路淹水，聯合、美國與達美航廈道路中斷。
body: 倫敦希斯洛機場周邊一條主水管破裂引發淹水，導致中央航廈附近的道路遭水淹沒，造成現場旅客與工作人員受困滯留。
這起積水事件已切斷並關閉通往 United、American 與 Delta 航廈的道路交通，使得相關航廈的陸路連結無法通行。
淹水區域主要集中於希斯洛機場中央航廈周邊幹道，受影響的航廈包含 United、American 及 Delta 航廈。
根據 Simple Flying 消息，道路關閉致使車輛無法正常進入該區，使得現場旅客與工作人員遭滯留於當地。

en.title: London Heathrow (LHR) Flooding Cuts Road Access to United, American, and Delta Terminals
en.summary: Flooding from a burst water main at London Heathrow blocked road access to United, American, and Delta terminals.
body: A burst water main has submerged roads surrounding the central terminals at London Heathrow Airport, causing road access disruptions across the immediate area. The flooding stranded passengers and airport staff who were attempting to travel through the affected terminal roads.
The road closure directly affected access to terminals utilized by United, American, and Delta. Vehicle traffic toward these central facilities was cut off as water covered the key roadway routes.

According to Simple Flying, the submerged roads left travelers and workers unable to enter or exit the terminal area by vehicle while road access to the United, American, and Delta terminals remained shut.
